name: Minidash
short_desc: Minimal, lightweight self-hosted dashboard with status checks, themes, and sections.
description: A minimal, lightweight self-hosted homelab dashboard — a single Go binary. Point it at a YAML config and get a clean page of shortcuts with icons, colors, themes, multiple views, optional sections, status checks, and more. Features 4 dashboard views, 11 themes including Catppuccin/Nord/Dracula/Gruvbox, per-link health monitoring with sparkline history, searchable icon picker with Simple Icons/Lucide/Tabler bundled offline, password-gated settings with drag-to-reorder, custom CSS, and hot-reloading config.
author: dvidbruhm

form_fields.label: Settings password (gates the Settings page — dashboard is public)
